units: metres, three.js world (Y up): p = (bx, bz, -by)

sun.note: direction points from the scene toward the sun

sky.note: the prototype's sky (one world shader for the whole path)
sky.textureMapping: equirectangular, three.js convention (u=0.5 is +X/east, u=0.25 north); sRGB, already tone-mapped (AgX Punchy, exposure +0.25)

fog.note: Blender haze: exponential height fog, extinction density*exp(-(y-baseY)/falloff) per m.

moon.note: self-lit; drawn by the page (not in the GLBs); click target 'moon'

bake.colour: Baked atlases, tree textures, card sprites and vertex colours are display-referred sRGB (Blender AgX / AgX - Punchy, exposure 1.2, look.py CDL grade, saturation 1.15 already applied). All materials are KHR_materials_unlit: draw with no tone mapping so the pixels round-trip.
bake.glow: Emissive surfaces are separate primitives; material and node extras carry {"glow": strength, "glowTint": "#rrggbb"}. Multiply the colour by the strength (toward the tint) so only they bloom.
bake.chunks: manifest.json v2: 'global' (backdrop, backdrop_trees, backdrop_water) always loaded; per area <area>.glb.gz (baked atlases, hotspot nodes), <area>_trees.glb.gz (instanced near trees, cards; plant hotspots 'trees.hs.<id>'), <area>_water.glb.gz (waterfall sheets, streams). Backdrop nodes with extras {"proxyOf": area} stand in for an area while its chunk is not drawn. Faces split into compact pieces (extras {"chunk": 1}) for culling: do not merge them back.
bake.hotspots: Nodes with extras {hotspot, label} (named 'hotspot.<id>' or 'trees.hs.<id>'); meta.hotspots carry the click boxes, area and chunk. 'moon' is meta-only (meta.moon).
bake.notBaked: Haze/fog, cloud sea and banks (clouds.json), the moon, the sky (sky.webp), light beams (meta.beams), the formation dome and pillar are drawn by the page, not in the GLBs.
bake.packed: tools/sect_pack.py --profile full: weld, area files simplified below 0.5 px of error at 1080 lines (content items and glow pieces exact), unlit, WebP q82, meshopt (positions 16 bit, UVs 14 bit; zero-area triangles dropped; float water UVs on a 2^-18 grid of their extent; vertex codec 1, KHR_meshopt_compression), gzip; low/ copies with textures <= 2048 px.
